## Project Tracker 1.1.5

- New milestone percentages now add to current progress as the next step, rather than being treated as the project total. The form shows the remaining amount and prevents progress from exceeding 100%.
- Updated the app icon to a flat fluorescent rising graph on a black background across Android and the web preview.

The release includes the transparent, independently configured project widget, local reminders, local project storage, and milestone editing. Project data stays on-device.

Download `Project-Tracker.apk`. It uses your private release key if GitHub Actions signing secrets are configured; otherwise it is debug-signed.
